SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.business_number AS business_number, u.status AS status, u.created_at AS created_at, u.title AS title, (SELECT TOP 1 cm.name FROM tb_user_industry ui JOIN tb_code cm ON cm.code = ui.industry_code AND cm.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND cm.active = 1 WHERE ui.user_id = u.id) AS industry_name, c.industry_other AS industry_other, (SELECT TOP 1 d.name FROM tb_user_department ud JOIN tb_department d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE ud.user_id = u.id) AS contract_dept_name FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = u.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = u.company_id AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.business_number AS business_number, u.status AS status, u.created_at AS created_at, u.approved_at AS approved_at, u.approved_by AS approved_by FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = u.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0
SELECT d.code AS code, d.name AS name FROM tb_user_department ud INNER JOIN tb_department d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.name
